items.title: Form Five admission for 2026/2027 is now open
items.summary: Prospective students and families can collect admission information from the Fuoni Migombani campus.
items.body: Zan Plan Academy is welcoming applications for Form Five in the 2026/2027 academic year. Visit the Fuoni Migombani campus for the admission pack, requirements and guidance on choosing a subject combination.

items.title: Science laboratories upgraded for practical learning
items.summary: New equipment and refreshed workspaces are helping Form Five learners build confidence in the lab.
items.body: Our Physics and Chemistry laboratories have been refreshed with additional practical equipment and improved storage. The upgrade gives Form Five learners more time for hands-on investigation and safer, better-organised experiments.

items.title: ZPA learners post strong mock examination results
items.summary: Teachers celebrate improved performance across the science streams after a focused revision cycle.
items.body: Learners across Form Five and Form Six showed strong progress in the latest mock examinations. The results reflect consistent revision, targeted feedback from teachers and a renewed focus on exam technique.
